title: Only as Safe as the Weakest Agent: A Break That Appears Only When the System Is Multi-Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.17520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Major industry multi-agent systems like Codex and Claude Code can be broken by attacks that have long been unsuccessful against modern frontier models. AI Safety as a discipline has largely focused on finding the bounds and vulnerabilities of AI models used in isolation. Yet as humans increasingly deploy these models as agents and multi-agent systems, the same attacks that had been thought to be patched when using a model in isolation can break these same models under specific circumstances. We show that these system breaks are not purely theoretical, but can break Claude Code, Codex, and a reference harness, all unmodified and used with their own sub-agent mechanisms. We show the attack by asking agents to answer questions from a store of files on disk in which we have planted a forged record. translated_title: 安全性仅取决于最弱的智能体：仅在多智能体系统中才会出现的漏洞
translated_abstract: Codex 和 Claude Code 等主要行业多智能体系统可以被长期以来对现代前沿模型无效的攻击所攻破。AI 安全作为一门学科，主要专注于发现孤立使用的 AI 模型的边界和漏洞。然而，随着人类越来越多地将这些模型部署为智能体和多智能体系统，那些被认为在单独使用模型时已经修复的攻击，在特定情况下可能会攻破同样的模型。我们证明这些系统破坏并非纯粹的理论假设，而是可以在未经修改、使用其自身子智能体机制的情况下攻破 Claude Code、Codex 和一个参考框架。我们通过要求智能体从磁盘上的文件存储库中回答问题来展示这种攻击，其中我们植入了一条伪造记录。当强模型协调器自行搜索该存储库时，在超过 1,000 次试验中几乎没有进行有害修订。然而，如果同样的……
tldr: 该论文揭示了单模型层面已修复的攻击可通过伪造文件记录等手段攻破 Claude Code 和 Codex 等多智能体系统的子智能体机制，表明多智能体系统的安全性受制于其最弱的智能体。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that attacks long considered patched against frontier models in isolation can break unmodified multi-agent systems like Claude Code and Codex through planted forged records, demonstrating that system safety is limited by its weakest agent.
